news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹91.16 (up from ₹86.91 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹3.74t (up 9.0% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹833.0b (up 7.4% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 22% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 61%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 6.0%. Revenue is expected to decline by 4.4% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Banks industry in India are expected to grow by 1.9%. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 10% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 18% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹17.35
news.body: Dividend of ₹17.35 is 9.1% higher than last year. Ex-date: 15th May 2026 Payment date: 4th June 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.8%, which is higher than the industry average of 1.1%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by earnings (18% payout ratio) and is expected to be well covered in 3 years' time (19% forecast payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 17% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 22% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: State Bank of India announces Annual dividend, payable on June 04, 2026
news.body: State Bank of India announced Annual dividend of INR 17.3500 per share payable on June 04, 2026, ex-date on May 15, 2026 and record date on May 16, 2026.

news.title: SBIN: Upcoming Meetings And Related Party Votes Will Shape Steady Outlook
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for State Bank of India broadly steady around ₹1,199, with only minor model adjustments to the discount rate and long term assumptions informing this update. What's in the News A board meeting is set for May 8, 2026 to consider and approve State Bank of India's financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026 (company filing).

news.title: SBIN: Upcoming Related Party Votes Will Support Governance And Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have inched down their price target on State Bank of India by about ₹1 to around ₹1,199, reflecting slightly higher discount rate and revenue growth assumptions, partly offset by a marginally firmer profit margin and a steady forward P/E. What's in the News A special shareholders meeting is scheduled for May 15, 2026 at 15:00 Indian Standard Time to address extraordinary matters requiring shareholder approval (Key Developments).

news.title: SBIN: Upcoming Related Party Approvals Will Support Governance And Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for State Bank of India by around ₹7, reflecting slightly adjusted assumptions on fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E that still remain broadly in line with prior views. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for Feb 7, 2026 at 10:00 Indian Standard Time to review financial results for the quarter ended Dec 31, 2025 and related regulatory disclosures, including security cover on non convertible debt securities and deviation or variation statements under SEBI (LODR) regulations, 2015 (Key Developments).

news.title: SBIN: Upcoming Shareholder Meetings Will Strengthen Governance And Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have inched their fair value estimate for State Bank of India slightly lower from about ₹1,207.82 to around ₹1,207.05, reflecting modest tweaks to assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E rather than any major shift in the core outlook. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for Feb 07, 2026 at 10:00 Indian Standard Time to consider financial results for the quarter ended Dec 31, 2025 and review related regulatory disclosures, including security cover certificates on non convertible debt securities and statements of deviation or variation under SEBI LODR regulations (Company event filing).

news.title: SBIN: New Leadership And Upcoming Governance Reviews Will Guide Balanced Outlook
news.body: The analyst price target for State Bank of India has been adjusted slightly higher from ₹1,200.26 to ₹1,207.82 as analysts refine their assumptions regarding the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for Feb 07, 2026 at 10:00 IST to consider financial results for the quarter ended Dec 31, 2025, review the security cover certificate on non convertible debt securities under SEBI LODR Regulation 54(3), and review statements of deviation or variation under Regulations 32 and 52(7)/52(7A) (Key Developments).

news.title: SBIN: New Leadership And Governance Reviews Will Shape Earnings Outlook
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on State Bank of India from ₹1,122.69 to ₹1,200.26, citing updated assumptions around revenue trends, profitability, and a slightly higher future P/E multiple. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for Feb 7, 2026, at 10:00 Indian Standard Time to consider financial results for the quarter ended Dec 31, 2025; review the security cover certificate on non convertible debt securities under SEBI (LODR) regulation 54(3); and review statements of deviation or variation under regulations 32 and 52(7)/52(7A) (Key Developments).

news.title: Price target increased by 7.3% to ₹1,193
news.body: Up from ₹1,112, the current price target is an average from 39 analysts. New target price is approximately in line with last closing price of ₹1,146. Stock is up 56% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹85.68 for next year compared to ₹86.91 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹23.09 (vs ₹21.12 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹23.09 (up from ₹21.12 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.01t (up 14% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹213.2b (up 13% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 21% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue is expected to decline by 3.4% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Banks industry in India are expected to grow by 2.5%. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 14% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 24% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: SBIN: New Leadership And Auditor Appointments Will Shape Earnings Outlook
news.body: Analysts have nudged up their fair value estimate for State Bank of India from ₹1,112.31 to ₹1,122.69, citing tweaks to discount rate assumptions, slightly different revenue growth and profit margin expectations, and a modest adjustment to future P/E multiples. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on February 7, 2026 at 10:00 Indian Standard Time to consider the financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, along with the Limited Review Report (company filing).

news.title: SBIN: Board Moves And Fund Management Stake Sale Will Shape Earnings
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for State Bank of India to ₹1,112 from ₹1,101, citing slightly adjusted assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and forward P/E, which together point to a marginally higher implied valuation. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for February 7, 2026 to consider State Bank of India's financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 (Board Meeting).

news.title: SBIN: Board Changes And Subsidiary Stake Sale Will Shape Future Earnings
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target for State Bank of India by about ₹24, reflecting slightly different assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E multiples in their updated models. What's in the News Ravi Ranjan has been appointed as Managing Director of State Bank of India, with responsibility for Risk, Compliance, and the Stressed Assets Resolution Group, effective from December 15, 2025, until his superannuation on September 30, 2028, or earlier if ordered (company filing).

news.title: SBIN: Subsidiary Stake Sale And Audit Changes Will Shape Future Earnings Profile
news.body: Analysts have nudged their price target on State Bank of India slightly higher to ₹1,077.36 from ₹1,076.59, citing marginal improvements in long term profit margin assumptions and a modestly lower discount rate that together support a slightly richer future earnings multiple. What's in the News State Bank of India received regulatory approval to appoint 10 Chartered Accountant firms as Statutory Central Auditors for FY 2025-26, including 8 continuing and 2 newly appointed firms, reinforcing audit oversight for the bank.

news.title: SBIN: Subsidiary IPO Stake Sale Will Support Stronger Future Earnings Potential
news.body: Analysts have modestly raised their price target for State Bank of India to ₹1,076.59 from ₹1,074.18, citing a slightly lower discount rate, stable long term revenue growth and profit margin assumptions, and a marginally higher forward P E multiple in their updated valuation model. What's in the News State Bank of India plans to sell a 6% stake, about 3.20 crore shares, in its subsidiary SBI Funds Management Limited via an IPO, alongside a 3.70% stake sale by co promoter Amundi India Holding.

news.title: SBIN: Stake Sale And Subsidiary IPO Will Influence Financial Outcomes This Year
news.body: Analysts have raised their price target for State Bank of India from ₹953.60 to ₹1,074.18, citing improved forecasts for revenue growth as well as a modest upward revision in future valuation multiples. What's in the News State Bank of India is preparing to sell a 6 percent stake, or 3.20 crore shares, in its subsidiary SBI Fund Management through an Initial Public Offering.
